# Moddy Scarcity Isle

Scarcity Isle, a Moddy level: a tiny island in the sky for every player, and a wish bank where every wish counts.

- **Your own island**, with a chest of ice and lava: where water and lava meet, cobblestone appears, and it comes back
  every time you mine it. Below the island is the void.
- **Grow it** from almost nothing into a home: wood and saplings from your tree, grass for animals, and the Isle
  Guide's sky island tricks for sand, iron and amethyst. The Nether has a small island of its own.
- **Wishes are scarce**: you start with a few and get more over time, up to a limit, and a ready-made wish costs half.
  Wishes work on your own island, not in the Nether.

Make a world with **Create World, World tab, World Type: Moddy Isle**. When you arrive you get the **Isle Guide** book;
the wish watch's **What do I do now?** shows your goals and their hints.

By **Moddy contributors**. Report problems [on its issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds/issues).

**Scope:** NeoForge. Each release names the Minecraft version it is for.

## Requirements

- Required: the Moddy core (mod id `moddingfromamod`), the release that this world's release notes name.

## Known issues

Known issues and their status: [its issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds/issues).

## How releases are made

Every release is built from https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds by its own build, passes automated checks (it
builds, its unit tests pass, and it loads on a dedicated server with the Moddy core), and is played by a person before
it becomes a full release.
